# Setup
## Load Packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

### ----- Load packages ----- ###
package_load <- function(package_names){
  for(i in 1:length(package_names)){
    if(!package_names[i] %in% installed.packages()){
      install.packages(package_names[i])
    }
    library(package_names[i],character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

#vector of packages
pack_req <- c( 
  # data wrangling packages
  "janitor", "broom","readxl","here","arrow",
  #spatial packages
  "sf","terra","raster","tmap","exactextractr",
  # plotting
  "ggpubr","ggthemes","patchwork", "gghighlight","grid", 
  "geomtextpath","plotly", "ggpmisc","officer", "flextable","kableExtra",
  #external datasets
  "cdssr","nhdplusTools","elevatr","prism",
  #stats
  "trend", "anomalize","rstatix", "car","performance","lme4","glmmTMB","emmeans","zyp", "ggeffects",
  #always load tidyverse last to avoid conflicts with other packages
  "tidyverse")
package_load(pack_req)

remove(pack_req, package_load)
```

## Grab data

```{r}
#discrete sample data and location metadata from most recent pub
data_folder <- here("data/raw/chem/ross_clp_chem/v2025.11.14")

most_recent_chem <- read_rds(here(data_folder, "data/cleaned/CLP_chemistry_up_to_20251114.rds"))%>%
  mutate(flow_gauge_id = ifelse(flow_gauge_source == "USGS", paste0("0", flow_gauge_id), flow_gauge_id))
most_recent_meta <- read_csv_arrow(here(data_folder,"data/metadata/location_metadata.csv"))

rm(units_meta_file)


tidy_chem <- most_recent_chem%>%
  #remove pre-fire and post study (2025) data
  filter(Year > 2020 & Year < 2025)%>%
  filter(watershed %nin% c("CLP Mainstem - Lower","CLP Tributary - Lower"))%>%
  # pfal + slep represent the same site but were moved to match future sensor location
  mutate(distance_upstream_km = case_when(site_code == "PFAL" ~ 73.9, TRUE ~ distance_upstream_km))%>%
  mutate(location_type = if_else(site_code == "PFAL", "Mainstem", location_type))%>%
  # add order table which gives the sites an order to be plotted in
  left_join(order_table, by = "site_code")%>%
  #filter site code BRNR with chla value of 0.02 
  filter(!(site_code == "BRNR" & ChlA == 0.02))%>%
  #filter site code CBRR with TSS value > 1000, seems to be sample error
  mutate( TSS = case_when((site_code == "CBRR" & TSS > 250) ~ NA_real_,
                          TSS >=50 ~ NA_real_,
                          TRUE ~ TSS),
           Turbidity = case_when((site_code == "CBRR" & Turbidity > 250) ~ NA_real_,
                          TRUE ~ Turbidity),
         # PTRR with ChlA of 0.22, seems to be sample error
          ChlA = case_when((site_code == "PTRR" & ChlA == 0.22) ~ NA_real_,
                          TRUE ~ ChlA),
          Year = as.character(Year), 
          month = as.character(month(Date)),
          season = case_when(
            month %in% c("3", "4") ~ "Rising Limb", 
            month %in% c( "5","6") ~ "Peak Flow",
            month %in% c("7", "8") ~ "Falling Limb",
            month %in% c("9", "10", "11") ~ "Fall Baseflow", 
            TRUE ~ "Winter"),
          burn_group = case_when(site_code %in% c("CBRR", "BRNR", "PTRR", "COMR", "HORR") ~ "burned", 
                                 TRUE ~ "unburned"), 
          burn_year = paste(burn_group, Year, sep = "_"), 
          site_year = paste(site_code, Year, sep = "_")
  )


```

## Chemistry Stats

### Filter Dataset and Assess Normality

```{r}
chem_transformed_res <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  ChlA, DOC:NO3, SO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  select(site_code, Date, Year, param, value, burn_group,season)%>%
  mutate(burn_group = factor(burn_group, levels = c("unburned", "burned")),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")), 
         season = factor(season),
         site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  mutate(value = if_else(value == 0 & param == "TSS", 0.1, value), 
         log_value = log(value))%>%
  na.omit()

param_oi <- c( "Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN","NH4", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "SO4", "ChlA")

ggplot(chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param %in% param_oi), aes(x = value, fill = burn_group))+
  geom_histogram(position = "stack")+
  #geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0.05), color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")

ggplot(chem_transformed_res%>%filter(param %in% param_oi), aes(x = log_value, fill = burn_group))+
  geom_histogram(position = "stack")+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")

```

Nothing without transformation is normal, we should double check model
assumptions with `check_model()` after creating a model then only
evaluate those that do. We will want to use a linear mixed effects model
to compare out burned vs unburned reservoirs

#### Counts near MDL

```{r}

mdl <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  select(site_code, Date, Year, param, value, burn_group,season)

mdl%>%
  group_by(param)%>%
  summarise(count_below_mdl = sum(value <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), 
            count_below_quant = sum(value <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_count = n(), 
            pct_below_mdl = (count_below_mdl/total_count)*100)
mdl%>%
  filter(param == "NH4")%>%
  group_by(site_code)%>%
  summarise(count_below_mdl = sum(value <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), 
            count_above_0.05 = sum(value > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            count_below_quant = sum(value <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_count = n(), 
            pct_below_mdl = (count_below_mdl/total_count)*100, 
            pct_above_quant = (count_above_0.05/total_count)*100)


```


### Test Burned vs Unburned

Fixed effects: burn type random effect: site

```{r}
check_lmm_models(
  df = chem_transformed_res,
  params = c("Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN", "NO3", "DOC", "SO4", "K", "ChlA"),
  full_formula_rhs = "burn_group + (1 | site_code)",
  gamma_params = "NO3"
)

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.
burned_unburned_res_results <- lmm_eval(
  df = chem_transformed_res,
  params = c("Turbidity", "TSS", "DTN", "NO3", "DOC", "SO4", "K", "ChlA"),
  group_var = "burn_group",
  full_formula_rhs = "burn_group + (1 | site_code)",
  null_formula_rhs = "1 + (1 | site_code)",
  gamma_params = "NO3"
)

burned_unburned_res_results$contrasts%>%
  filter(parameter == "K")

flip_contrasts(burned_unburned_res_results$contrasts)


```

### Time Series plots of NO3 + TDN + Chl-a for a reservoir

```{r}
#Create winter gaps so there is no line connecting the last point of the year to the first point of the next year
winter_gaps <- all_reservoirs %>%
  map_df(~{
    seq(as.Date("2020-12-31"), as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "year") %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      rename(Date = value) %>%
      mutate(site_code = .x, ChlA = NA, NO3 = NA, DTN = NA)
  })


plot_data <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% all_reservoirs & !is.na(NO3) & !is.na(ChlA) & !is.na(DTN)) %>%
  bind_rows(winter_gaps) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, ChlA, DTN, TSS), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")%>%
  #remove any NAs if the month is not december
  select(site_code, Date, parameter, value, season)%>%
  mutate(month = month(Date))%>%
  filter((!is.na(value) | month(Date) == 12))

make_grid_plot <- function(site, param, y_limit, pos_index, total_sites) {
  
  is_left_edge <- (pos_index == 1)
  is_right_edge <- (pos_index == total_sites)
  show_title <- (param == "DTN") # Titles only on top row
  
  p <- plot_data %>%
    filter(site_code == site, parameter == param) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(color = season)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = season_clp_color_vals, na.translate = FALSE) +
    ylim(0, y_limit) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = chem_expressions[[param]], color = "Season")
  
  #If NOT on the left or right edge, strip the y-axis text and titles
  if (!is_left_edge && !is_right_edge) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
  }
  
  # Add Reservoir Titles to the top row only
  if (show_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(site)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

n_res <- length(all_reservoirs)

dtn_plots <- imap(all_reservoirs, ~make_grid_plot(.x, "DTN", 1, .y, n_res))
no3_plots <- imap(all_reservoirs, ~make_grid_plot(.x, "NO3", 2.5, .y, n_res))
chla_plots <- imap(all_reservoirs, ~make_grid_plot(.x, "ChlA", 10, .y, n_res))

# Build Final Plot with shared legend and bottom legend position
final_plot <- wrap_plots(c(dtn_plots, no3_plots, chla_plots), ncol = n_res) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Display the plot
final_plot
```

## Stats

#### ChlA Counts

##### Max min

```{r}
 tidy_chem%>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  summarise(mean_chla = mean(ChlA), 
            median_chla = median(ChlA), 
            min_chla = min(ChlA), 
            max_chla = max(ChlA), 
            sd_chla = sd(ChlA))
```

##### Counts of each Trophic Status

```{r}

res_trophic_status <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  #classify
  mutate(eu_status  = case_when(ChlA >= 2.6 &ChlA <= 8 ~ "Mesotrophic", 
                                ChlA > 8 ~ "Eutrophic",
                                ChlA < 2.6 ~ "Oligotrophic"))

res_trophic_status%>%
  group_by(site_code,eu_status)%>%
  summarise(eu_stats = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-site_code), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
         perc_meso = round((Mesotrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),
         perc_meso_eu = round(((Eutrophic+Mesotrophic)/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1))

res_trophic_status%>%
  group_by(burn_group, eu_status)%>%
  summarise(eu_stats = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-burn_group), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),

        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1), 
    n_meso_eu = Eutrophic + Mesotrophic)



res_trophic_status%>%
  group_by( Year, eu_status, burn_group)%>%
  summarise(eu_stats = n())%>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-Year), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
         perc_meso = round((Mesotrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),
         perc_meso_eu = round(((Eutrophic+Mesotrophic)/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1),
    Year = as.character(Year))
```

### Seaonal Exceedence

"Impairment means: “…summer Chl-a (July 1–September 30) seasonal average of values from the mixed layer…"
Calculate the average Chl-a for each reservoir for the summer months (July 1 - September 30) and then compare to the impairment threshold of 8 ug/L.

```{r}
tidy_chem%>% 
  filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% c(primary_study_res, "COMR", "HORR"))%>%
  filter(month(Date) %in% c(7,8,9))%>%
  group_by(site_code, Year)%>%
  summarise(mean_chla = mean(ChlA), .groups = "drop")%>%
  mutate(exceedance = ifelse(mean_chla >= 8, "Exceedance", "No Exceedance"))%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = c(mean_chla, exceedance))

```

### CN-Chla relationships ratios in reservoirs

```{r}

# Determine how many reservoirs you have to create enough vertical spacing
cn_dataset <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("BRNR", "CBRR", "JOER", "LNGR", "PTRR") & !is.na(NO3) & !is.na(DOC) & !is.na(DTN) & !is.na(ChlA))%>%
  mutate(CN = DOC/DTN, 
         NO3_DTN = NO3/DTN)

  cn_model <- cn_dataset %>%
    select(site_code, season, Year, NO3,DOC, DTN, TSS, CN, ChlA, NO3_DTN)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, DOC, DTN, CN, NO3_DTN, TSS), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
    mutate(value = if_else(value == 0 & param == "TSS", 0.1, value))%>%
    filter(value > 0) %>%  # Ensure positive values for log transformation)
    mutate(log_ChlA = log(ChlA), 
           log_pred    = log(value), 
           param = factor(param, levels = c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN","TSS", "CN", "NO3_DTN")), 
           site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("BRNR", "CBRR", "JOER", "LNGR", "PTRR")), 
           season = factor(season, levels = c("Peak Flow", "Rising Limb", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow", "Winter")))


# If diagnostics pass, extract estimates, % change, and p-values
model_results <-  map(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN","TSS", "CN", "NO3_DTN"), ~{
  
  df <- cn_model %>%
    filter(param == .x, value > 0) # Ensure positive values for log transformation
  
  model_full <- lmer(log_ChlA ~ log_pred + (1 | site_code) + (1 |season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  model_null <- lmer(log_ChlA ~ 1        + (1 | site_code) + (1 | season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  anova_res  <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  conf       <- confint(model_full, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
  estimate   <- fixef(model_full)["log_pred"]   # slope on log-log scale = elasticity
  
  # Marginal R2 (variance explained by fixed effects only)
  r2_vals    <- r2(model_full)   # from performance package
  
  tibble(
    param          = .x,
    estimate       = estimate,               # log-log slope
    ci_low = conf["log_pred", 1],
    ci_high = conf["log_pred", 2],
    marginal_r2    = r2_vals$R2_marginal,
    conditional_r2 = r2_vals$R2_conditional,
    p_value        = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      p_sig             = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", ""),
      significant_effect = case_when(
        p_value >= 0.05  ~ "No Significant Relationship",
        estimate > 0     ~ "Positive Relationship with ChlA",
        TRUE             ~ "Negative Relationship with ChlA"
      )
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(p_value)
 
 # Make a plot of all of these colored by reservoir and add the model fit lines for each parameter. We can also add the confidence intervals for the model fits as ribbons around the lines.
 
 param_labels <- c(
  "NO3" = "NO[3]^{'-'}~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "DOC" = "DOC~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "DTN" = "TDN~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "CN"  = "DOC:TDN~ratio", 
  "TSS" = "TSS~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "NO3_DTN" = "NO[3]^{'-'}:TDN~ratio"
)


# Re-run models and store them in a named list
models <- map(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN", "CN","TSS", "NO3_DTN"), ~{
  df <- cn_model %>% filter(param == .x, value > 0)
  lmer(log_ChlA ~ log_pred + (1 | site_code) + (1 | season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
}) %>% set_names(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN", "CN", "TSS", "NO3_DTN"))

# Generate marginal predictions (fixed effects only) for each model
pred_df <- imap_dfr(models, ~{
  ggpredict(.x, terms = "log_pred [all]") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(param = .y)
})

anno_df <- model_results %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "β = ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", R² = ", round(marginal_r2, 2),
      ", p = ", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_value, 3))
    ),
    fontface = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "bold", "plain")
  )
# Plot
ggplot(cn_model, aes(x = log_pred, y = log_ChlA)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = site_code), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted),
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
    data = anno_df,
    aes(label = label, fontface = fontface),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.2, vjust = 2,
    size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~param,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = labeller(param = as_labeller(param_labels, default = label_parsed))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "log(Predictor)", y = "log(Chl-a)", color = "Reservoir") +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggsave("docs/cpf_reservoir/paper_draft/cn_chla_relationships_reservoirs.jpg", dpi = 500, width = 8, height = 6)
```


# Longitudinal Reservoir Chemistry

```{r}

res_network <- tibble(
  watershed           = c("JOER", "LNGR", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR"), 
  reservoir_site_code = c("JOER", "LNGR", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR"),
  inflow_site_code    = c("JOEI", NA,     "CBRI", NA,     NA), 
  outflow_site_code   = c("CBRI", "LNGO", "CHD",  "PTRO", "BMD")
)

# 2. Reshape res_network into a lookup table
res_network_long <- res_network %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_site_code"),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "site_code"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_code)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean up position name ("inflow_site_code" -> "Inflow")
    position = str_remove(position, "_site_code") %>% str_to_title(),
    position = factor(position, levels = c("Inflow", "Reservoir", "Outflow"))
  )

# 3. Join with chemistry data (CBRI rows automatically duplicate here)
longitudinal_chem <- tidy_chem %>%
  #filter(site_code %in% c("JOEI", "JOER", "CBRR", "CBRI", "CHD", "JWC")) %>%
  select(Date, site_code, ChlA, NO3, DTN, DOC, Year) %>%
  # Join duplicates CBRI into both JOER (Outflow) and CBRR (Inflow)
  inner_join(res_network_long, by = "site_code", relationship = "many-to-many")

ggplot(longitudinal_chem, aes(x = position, y = ChlA)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_wrap(~watershed, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Longitudinal Chl-a Concentrations", x = "Position in Reservoir Network", y = "Chl-a (ug/L)") +
  ROSS_theme
```

### Compare relationship between inflow NO3/TDN and outflow chla

```{r}

# 1. Prepare inflow/outflow dataset
inflow_outflow_data <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("JOEI", "JOER", "CBRI", "CBRR", "CHD", "JWC")) %>%
  #remove row where JOEI NO3 is super low
  filter(!(site_code == "JOEI" & NO3 <= 0.02)) %>%
  select(Date, site_code, Year, season, NO3, ChlA, DTN) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, ChlA, DTN), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    param = factor(param, levels = c("NO3", "ChlA", "DTN")),
    site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("JOEI", "JOER", "CBRI", "CBRR", "CHD", "JWC")),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Peak Flow", "Rising Limb", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow", "Winter")), 
    Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Date, Year, season),
    names_from = c(site_code, param), 
    values_from = value, 
    names_glue = "{site_code}_{param}"
  )

# 2. Define model pairs with explicit plotmath X and Y axis labels per model
pairs_df <- tribble(
  ~model_id,           ~predictor_col, ~response_col, ~x_lab,                                  ~y_lab,
  "JOER_Inflow_NO3",   "JOEI_NO3",     "JOER_ChlA",   "log(JOEI~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",      "log(JOER~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",
  
  "JOER_NO3",   "JOER_NO3",     "JOER_ChlA",   "log(JOER~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",              "log(JOER~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",
  "CBRI_Outflow_NO3",  "CBRI_NO3",     "CBRI_ChlA",   "log(CBRI~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",      "log(CBRI~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",
  "CBRR_Inflow_NO3",   "CBRI_NO3",     "CBRR_ChlA",   "log(CBRI~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",      "log(CBRR~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",
  "CBRR_NO3",   "CBRR_NO3",     "CBRR_ChlA",   "log(CBRR~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",              "log(CBRR~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",
  "CHD_Outflow_NO3",   "CHD_NO3",      "CHD_ChlA",    "log(CHD~NO[3]^{'-'}~~mg~L^{-1})",       "log(CHD~Chl*a~~mu*g~L^{-1})",)

# 3. Model fitting function
fit_inflow_outflow_model <- function(data, predictor_col, response_col, model_id) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[response_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      log_response  = log(.data[[response_col]]),
      log_predictor = log(.data[[predictor_col]])
    )
  
  model_full <- lmer(log_response ~ log_predictor  + (1 | Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  model_null <- lmer(log_response ~ 1              + (1 | Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  conf      <- confint(model_full, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
  estimate  <- fixef(model_full)["log_predictor"]
  r2_vals   <- r2(model_full)
  
  tibble(
    model_id       = model_id,
    predictor      = predictor_col,
    response       = response_col,
    n              = nrow(df),
    estimate       = estimate,
    ci_low         = conf["log_predictor", 1],
    ci_high        = conf["log_predictor", 2],
    marginal_r2    = r2_vals$R2_marginal,
    conditional_r2 = r2_vals$R2_conditional,
    p_value        = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(p_sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))
}

# 4. Run models and compile tabular results
model_results <- pmap_dfr(pairs_df, function(model_id, predictor_col, response_col, ...) {
  fit_inflow_outflow_model(inflow_outflow_data, predictor_col, response_col, model_id)
})

# 5. Fit models for visualization
models <- pmap(pairs_df, function(model_id, predictor_col, response_col, ...) {
  df <- inflow_outflow_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[response_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      log_response  = log(.data[[response_col]]),
      log_predictor = log(.data[[predictor_col]])
    )
  
  lmer(log_response ~ log_predictor + (1 | Year), data = df, REML = FALSE)
}) %>% set_names(pairs_df$model_id)

# 6. Generate marginal predictions for plotting lines + CIs
pred_df <- imap_dfr(models, ~{
  ggpredict(.x, terms = "log_predictor [all]") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(model_id = .y)
})

# 7. Build long-format data for scatter points
plot_data <- pmap_dfr(pairs_df, function(model_id, predictor_col, response_col, ...) {
  inflow_outflow_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[response_col]])) %>%
    transmute(
      Year, season,
      log_predictor = log(.data[[predictor_col]]),
      log_response  = log(.data[[response_col]]),
      model_id      = model_id
    )
})

# 8. Statistical annotations per model
anno_df <- model_results %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "β = ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", R² = ", round(marginal_r2, 2),
      ", p = ", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_value, 3))
    ),
    fontface = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "bold", "plain")
  )

# 9. Build individual plot objects for each pair
plot_list <- pmap(pairs_df, function(model_id, predictor_col, response_col, x_lab, y_lab) {
  
  sub_plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(model_id == !!model_id)
  sub_pred_df   <- pred_df   %>% filter(model_id == !!model_id)
  sub_anno_df   <- anno_df   %>% filter(model_id == !!model_id)
  
  ggplot(sub_plot_data, aes(x = log_predictor, y = log_response)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = season), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(data = sub_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_ribbon(data = sub_pred_df, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
      data = sub_anno_df,
      aes(label = label, fontface = fontface),
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.8,
      size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = parse(text = x_lab),
      y = parse(text = y_lab),
      color = "Season"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = season_clp_color_vals) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
})

# 10. Assemble grid with patchwork and consolidate shared season legend
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Display final figure
combined_plot 
ggsave("docs/cpf_reservoir/paper_draft/jwc_inflow_outflow_relationships.jpg", 
       plot = combined_plot, dpi = 500, width = 14, height = 8)
```

## Stats

### Sitewise LME
Compare site chla variability with levene test and means using mixed model 
Fixed: Site
Random: Season + Year



```{r}

clp_long_stats <-  tidy_chem  %>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA)& Year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024)) %>%
  mutate(site_code  = case_when(site_code == "SLEP" ~ "PFAL",
                           site_code == "PMAN" ~ "PNF",
                           TRUE ~ site_code))%>%
  dplyr::filter(site_code %in% c("JWC", "PJW", "PFAL","SFM", "PBR", "PSF", "PNF", "PBD"))%>%
  select(Date,site_code, ChlA, NO3, DTN,DOC,K,Year,season, month,location_type)%>%
  mutate(location_type = ifelse(location_type == "Outflow"|location_type =="Inflow", "Stream", "Reservoir"))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA, NO3, DOC, DTN, K), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(Year, Date,season, site_code, param))%>%
  mutate(log_value = log(value),
         Year = factor(Year, levels = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024")),
         season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Rising Limb", "Peak Flow", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow")))

site_check <- map(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3", "ChlA"), ~{
  df <- clp_long_stats%>%filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  #Since NO3 does not fit a normal distribution, we will use a generalized linear mixed model with a gamma distribution and log link for NO3, and linear mixed models for the other parameters.
  if(.x == "NO3"){
    model_gamma <- glmmTMB(value ~ site_code + (1|Year) + (1|season), 
                           data = df, 
                           family = Gamma(link = "log"))
    
    return(check_model(model_gamma))
  }
  model_full <- lmer(log_value ~ site_code + season + (1|Year) + (1|season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  check_model(model_full)
})%>%
  set_names(c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"))

# If they pass the model diagnostics, extract the estimate for burn_group and calculate the percent difference between burned and unburned reservoirs. Then compare the full model to a null model without burn_group using an ANOVA to get the p-value for the effect of burn_group.

clp_long_eval <- lmm_eval(
  df = clp_long_stats,
  params = c("DTN", "K", "DOC", "NO3","ChlA"),
  group_var = "site_code",
  full_formula_rhs = "site_code + (1|Year) + (1|season)",
  null_formula_rhs = "season + (1 | Year) + (1 | season)",
  gamma_params = "NO3"
)

clp_long_eval$contrasts%>%
  filter(parameter == "NO3")%>%
  filter(grepl("PBR", contrast))%>%
  arrange(desc(pct_est))

flip_contrasts(clp_long_eval$contrasts)%>%
  filter(parameter == "DTN")%>%
  arrange(desc(pct_est))

clp_long_stats%>%
  #filter(param == "")%>%
  mutate(site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("JWC", "PJW", "PFAL", "PBR", "PSF", "PNF", "PBD")))%>%
ggplot(., aes(x = site_code, y = value, fill = site_code))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "ChlA Concentration by Site", x = "Site Code", y = "value")+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free")

clp_long_stats%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Date, Year, season, site_code), names_from = param, values_from = value)%>%
  mutate(no3_tdn  = NO3/DTN)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = K, y = ChlA, color = site_code))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F)+
  facet_wrap(~Year)
  labs(title = "ChlA vs K by Site", x = "K (mg/L)", y = "ChlA (µg/L)")+
  ROSS_theme

```

### Res Prop/Impact Metric
Calculate the metric of reservoir impact: acre ft impounded water storage/ watershed area 
Does this correlate with Chl-a across the basin?


```{r}
# NID = https://nid.sec.usace.army.mil/nid/#/downloads
dams <- st_read('data/raw/external_datasets/inventory_of_dams/nation_20260313.gpkg') %>%
  filter(state %in% "Colorado",
         grepl("Water Supply|Irrigation", purposeIds, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  st_transform(4326)%>%
  select(name, nidId, ownerNames, latitude, longitude, riverName,nidStorage,purposeIds,normalStorage,maxStorage )


#read in watersheds 
watersheds <- st_read(dsn = here(spatial_dir,"cpf_watersheds.shp"))%>%
  left_join(most_recent_meta, by = c("site_code"))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% c( "JWC","PJW", "PFAL", "PBR","PSF","PNF", "PBD",  "SFM", "BEAV"))

dams_watersheds <- map(1:nrow(watersheds), ~{
  
  watershed_sel <- watersheds[.x,]
  
  dams_in_watershed <- st_join(dams, watershed_sel, join = st_intersects) %>%
    filter(!is.na(site_code)) 
  
  if(nrow(dams_in_watershed) == 0){
    return(tibble(site_code = watershed_sel$site_code, 
                  location_type = watershed_sel$location_type,
                  total_storage_acre_ft = 0, 
                  watershed_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(watershed_sel) / 1e6)))
  }
  
  
  
  return(tibble(watershed_area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(watershed_sel) / 1e6), 
                site_code = unique(watershed_sel$site_code), 
                  location_type = watershed_sel$location_type,
                total_storage_acre_ft = sum(as.numeric(dams_in_watershed$normalStorage), na.rm = TRUE)))
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  mutate(location_type = case_when(site_code == "CBRI" ~ "Outflow", 
                                   site_code %in% c("SFM", "JWC") ~ "Stream",
                                   site_code == "PFAL" ~ "Mainstem",
                                   TRUE ~location_type))%>%
  filter(location_type != "Outflow" & site_code %nin% c("LBEA", "PENN"))

highlight_sites <- c("pbd", "pnf", "jwc", "pfal", "pbr", "psf", "pjw", "sfm", "beav")%>%toupper()

mainstem_site_colors <- c(
  "JWC" = "#772f1a",
  "PJW" = "#56B4E9",
  "PFAL" = "#E69F00",
  "PBR" = "#F0E442",
  "PSF" = "#0072B2",
  "PNF" = "#D55E00",
  "PBD" = "#009E73", 
  "BEAV" = "#CC79A7",
  "SFM" = "#999999"
)

 tidy_chem %>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA)) %>%
  filter(!(site_code %in% c("BEAV", "SFM") & Year %in% c("2021", "2022")))%>%
  select(site_code, Date, ChlA)%>%
  left_join(dams_watersheds, by = "site_code") %>%
  mutate(total_storage_mm3 = total_storage_acre_ft * 1233.48 / 1e6,
    impounded_ws_area = total_storage_mm3 / watershed_area_km2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(impounded_ws_area)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = impounded_ws_area, y = ChlA, color = site_code))+
  geom_point()+
  #geom_smooth( aes(x = impounded_ws_area, y = ChlA), method = "lm", se = FALSE, inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  #scale_y_log10()+
  scale_color_manual(values = mainstem_site_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Upstream Impounded Water/ Watershed Area (Mm3/km2)", 
       y = "Chlorophyll a (µg/L)", 
       color = "Site Code")+
   xlim(0, 0.3)

filtered_dams <- st_join(dams, watersheds%>%filter(site_code == "PBD"), join = st_intersects) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_code))
 
tmap_mode("view")
tm_basemap("Esri.WorldImagery")+
tm_shape(watersheds%>%filter(site_code == "PBD")) +
```

## CN relationship in Mainstem sites

```{r}

# Determine how many reservoirs you have to create enough vertical spacing
cn_dataset <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(!is.na(NO3) & !is.na(DOC) & !is.na(DTN) & !is.na(ChlA) & Year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024)) %>%
  mutate(site_code  = case_when(site_code == "SLEP" ~ "PFAL",
                           site_code == "PMAN" ~ "PNF",
                           TRUE ~ site_code))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("JWC", "PJW", "PFAL","PBR",  "PSF", "PNF", "PBD"))%>%
  mutate(CN = DOC/DTN, 
         NO3_DTN = NO3/DTN)

  cn_model <- cn_dataset %>%
    select(site_code, season, Year, NO3,DOC, DTN, CN, TSS, ChlA, NO3_DTN)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, DOC, DTN, CN,TSS, NO3_DTN), names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
    mutate(value = if_else(value == 0 & param == "TSS", 0.01, value))%>% # Replace 0 with a small value for TSS
    filter(value > 0) %>%  # Ensure positive values for log transformation
    mutate(log_ChlA = log(ChlA), 
           log_pred    = log(value), 
           param = factor(param, levels = c("NO3", "DOC", "TSS", "DTN", "CN", "NO3_DTN")), 
           site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("JWC", "PJW", "PFAL","PBR",  "PSF", "PNF", "PBD")), 
           season = factor(season, levels = c("Peak Flow", "Rising Limb", "Falling Limb", "Fall Baseflow", "Winter")))


# If diagnostics pass, extract estimates, % change, and p-values
model_results <-  map(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN", "CN","TSS", "NO3_DTN"), ~{
  
  df <- cn_model %>%
    filter(param == .x, value > 0) # Ensure positive values for log transformation
  
  model_full <- lmer(log_ChlA ~ log_pred + (1 | site_code) + (1 |season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  model_null <- lmer(log_ChlA ~ 1        + (1 | site_code) + (1 |season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  
  anova_res  <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  conf       <- confint(model_full, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
  estimate   <- fixef(model_full)["log_pred"]   # slope on log-log scale = elasticity
  
  # Marginal R2 (variance explained by fixed effects only)
  r2_vals    <- r2(model_full)   # from performance package
  
  tibble(
    param          = .x,
    estimate       = estimate,               # log-log slope
    ci_low = conf["log_pred", 1],
    ci_high = conf["log_pred", 2],
    marginal_r2    = r2_vals$R2_marginal,
    conditional_r2 = r2_vals$R2_conditional,
    p_value        = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      p_sig             = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", ""),
      significant_effect = case_when(
        p_value >= 0.05  ~ "No Significant Relationship",
        estimate > 0     ~ "Positive Relationship with ChlA",
        TRUE             ~ "Negative Relationship with ChlA"
      )
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(p_value)
 
 # Make a plot of all of these colored by reservoir and add the model fit lines for each parameter. We can also add the confidence intervals for the model fits as ribbons around the lines.
 
 param_labels <- c(
  "NO3" = "NO[3]^{'-'}~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "DOC" = "DOC~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "DTN" = "TDN~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "CN"  = "DOC:TDN~ratio", 
  "TSS" = "TSS~(mg~L^{-1})",
  "NO3_DTN" = "NO[3]^{'-'}:TDN~ratio"
)


# Re-run models and store them in a named list
models <- map(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN", "TSS", "CN", "NO3_DTN"), ~{
  df <- cn_model %>% filter(param == .x, value > 0)
  lmer(log_ChlA ~ log_pred + (1 | site_code) + (1 | season), data = df, REML = FALSE)
}) %>% set_names(c("NO3", "DOC", "DTN", "TSS", "CN", "NO3_DTN"))

# Generate marginal predictions (fixed effects only) for each model
pred_df <- imap_dfr(models, ~{
  ggpredict(.x, terms = "log_pred [all]") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(param = .y)
})

anno_df <- model_results %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "β = ", round(estimate, 2),
      ", R² = ", round(marginal_r2, 2),
      ", p = ", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_value, 3))
    ),
    fontface = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "bold", "plain")
  )

mainstem_site_colors <- c(
  "JWC" = "#772f1a",
  "PJW" = "#56B4E9",
  "PFAL" = "#E69F00",
  "PBR" = "#F0E442",
  "PSF" = "#0072B2",
  "PNF" = "#D55E00",
  "PBD" = "#009E73"
)
# Plot
ggplot(cn_model, aes(x = log_pred, y = log_ChlA)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = site_code, shape = season), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted),
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(
    data = anno_df,
    aes(label = label, fontface = fontface),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.2, vjust = 2,
    size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~param,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = labeller(param = as_labeller(param_labels, default = label_parsed))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mainstem_site_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "log(Predictor)", y = "log(Chl-a)", color = "Site", shape = "Season") +
  ROSS_theme+
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("docs/cpf_reservoir/paper_draft/cn_chla_relationships_mainstem.jpg", dpi = 500, width = 12, height = 8)
```

### Pre vs Post Fire Tests

```{r}

rs_tests <- all_rs %>%
  mutate(doy = yday(date), 
         year = year(date))%>%
  filter(site_code %nin% c("COMR", "HORR", "SEMR", "HALL"))%>%
  filter(doy >= 120 & doy <= 300) %>%
  filter(year >= 2016 & year != 2020)%>%
  select(site_code, gnis_name, date, doy, year, med_surface_C, mean_sdd)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(med_surface_C, mean_sdd), names_to = "param", values_to = "value")%>%
  mutate(log_value = log(value), 
         fire_status = factor(if_else(year < 2020, "Pre-Fire", "Post-Fire")))

ggplot(rs_tests, aes(x = value, fill = site_code))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(param~fire_status, scales = "free")+
  theme_bw() 

check_model(lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = rs_tests%>%filter(param == "med_surface_C" & value > 0),
    REML = FALSE
  ))
check_model(lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = rs_tests%>%filter(param == "mean_sdd" & value > 0),
    REML = FALSE
  ))

map(c("med_surface_C", "mean_sdd"), ~{
  
  df <- rs_tests %>%
    filter(param == .x & value > 0)
  
  # Full model - site × fire interaction
  model_full <- lmer(
    value ~ site_code * fire_status + (1|year),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  # Null model - no interaction
  model_null <- lmer(
    value ~ site_code + fire_status + (1|year),
    data = df,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  anova_res <- anova(model_null, model_full)
  
  # Estimated marginal means for each lake × fire period
  emm <- emmeans(model_full, ~ fire_status | site_code)
  
  contrasts <- summary(pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE),  # Post - Pre
                       infer = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(p_value_contrast = p.value)
  
  # Pre-fire baseline per lake for % change
  pre_means <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    filter(fire_status == "Pre-Fire") %>%
    select(site_code, pre_mean = emmean)
  
  contrasts %>%
    left_join(pre_means, by = "site_code") %>%
    mutate(
      p_value_anova = anova_res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      parameter     = .x
    )
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    diff      = estimate,
    diff_low  = lower.CL,
    diff_high = upper.CL,
    sig_stars = case_when(
      p_value_contrast < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value_contrast < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value_contrast < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE                     ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    site_code, contrast, parameter, pre_mean,
    diff, diff_low, diff_high,
    p_value_contrast, sig_stars, p_value_anova
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))%>%
  mutate(interp = case_when(p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "med_surface_C"& diff > 0 ~ "Temp Increase",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "med_surface_C"& diff < 0 ~ "Temp Decrease",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "mean_sdd"& diff > 0 ~ "Clarity Decrease",
                            p_value_contrast < 0.05 & parameter == "mean_sdd"& diff < 0 ~ "Clarity Increase",
                            TRUE ~ "No Significant Change"))

```

## SDD post fire slopes by site
Using sens slope on both detrended SDD and raw SDD to see if the trends are significant and if they are different from each other.

```{r}
 seasonAdjTrends <-  map_dfr(unique(all_rs$site_code), function(site){
    #use time_decompose to remove seasonal component
    all_rs %>% 
    mutate(doy = yday(date))%>%
    filter(site_code == site & !is.na(mean_sdd) & (doy >= 120 & doy <= 300))%>%
     filter(!(year(date) == 2020 & month(date) >= 8))%>%
    select(site_code,gnis_name, date, mean_sdd)%>%
    as_tibble() %>% 
    arrange(date) %>%
    time_decompose(mean_sdd, merge = T) 
  })%>%
   filter(site_code %nin% c("HORR", "COMR", "SEMR", "HALL"))  %>%
   filter(!is.na(trend) & mean_sdd > 0)%>%
  bind_rows(
    map_dfr(unique(rs_tests$site_code), function(i) {
      tibble(seq(from = as.Date("2015-12-31"), to = as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "1 year"))%>%
        rename(date = 1)%>%
        mutate(trend = NA, mean_sdd = NA, site_code = i, pre_fire = "Post-Fire")
    })
  )%>%
  mutate(gnis_name = case_when(
    site_code == "BRNR" ~ "Barnes Meadow Reservoir",
    site_code == "PTRR" ~ "Peterson Lake",
    site_code == "CBRR" ~ "Chambers Lake",
    site_code == "JOER" ~ "Joe Wright Reservoir",
    site_code == "LNGR" ~ "Long Draw Reservoir"
  ))
# Reusable function to compute Sen's slope trends for a given date range
compute_sens_trends <- function(data, year_min, year_max) {
  data %>%
    filter(year(date) >= year_min, year(date) <= year_max) %>%
    filter(!is.na(trend)) %>%
    arrange(site_code, date) %>%
    mutate(decimal_year = lubridate::decimal_date(date)) %>%
    group_by(site_code) %>%
    summarize(
      test_trend       = list(zyp.sen(trend ~ decimal_year, data = cur_data())),
      test_mean_sdd    = list(zyp.sen(mean_sdd ~ decimal_year, data = cur_data())),
      kendall_trend    = list(cor.test(decimal_year, trend, method = "kendall")),
      kendall_mean_sdd = list(cor.test(decimal_year, mean_sdd, method = "kendall")),
      date_min = min(date),
      date_max = max(date),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      trend_slope     = map_dbl(test_trend, ~ .x$coefficients[["decimal_year"]]),
      trend_intercept = map_dbl(test_trend, ~ .x$coefficients[["Intercept"]]),
      trend_p_value   = map_dbl(kendall_trend, ~ .x$p.value),
      trend_z_stat    = map_dbl(kendall_trend, ~ .x$statistic),
      trend_p_sig     = if_else(trend_p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"),

      sdd_slope     = map_dbl(test_mean_sdd, ~ .x$coefficients[["decimal_year"]]),
      sdd_intercept = map_dbl(test_mean_sdd, ~ .x$coefficients[["Intercept"]]),
      sdd_p_value   = map_dbl(kendall_mean_sdd, ~ .x$p.value),
      sdd_z_stat    = map_dbl(kendall_mean_sdd, ~ .x$statistic),
      sdd_p_sig     = if_else(sdd_p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")
    ) %>%
    select(-test_trend, -test_mean_sdd, -kendall_trend, -kendall_mean_sdd) %>%
    arrange(trend_slope) %>%
    select(site_code, date_min, date_max,
           trend_slope, trend_intercept, trend_p_value, trend_z_stat, trend_p_sig,
           raw_sdd_slope = sdd_slope, raw_sdd_intercept = sdd_intercept,
           raw_sdd_p_value = sdd_p_value, raw_sdd_z_stat = sdd_z_stat, raw_sdd_p_sig = sdd_p_sig)
}

# Reusable function to build the trend-line plotting data
build_trend_lines <- function(sens_trends) {
  sens_trends %>%
    mutate(
      decimal_year_min = lubridate::decimal_date(date_min),
      decimal_year_max = lubridate::decimal_date(date_max)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(decimal_year_min, decimal_year_max),
      names_to = "endpoint",
      values_to = "decimal_year"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      date      = lubridate::date_decimal(decimal_year) %>% as.Date(),
      trend_fit = ifelse(trend_p_sig == "*",
                         trend_intercept + trend_slope * decimal_year,NA),
      sdd_fit   = ifelse(raw_sdd_p_sig == "*",
                         raw_sdd_intercept + raw_sdd_slope * decimal_year,NA)
    ) %>%
    select(site_code, date, trend_fit, sdd_fit) %>%
    mutate(gnis_name = case_when(
      site_code == "BRNR" ~ "Barnes Meadow Reservoir",
      site_code == "PTRR" ~ "Peterson Lake",
      site_code == "CBRR" ~ "Chambers Lake",
      site_code == "JOER" ~ "Joe Wright Reservoir",
      site_code == "LNGR" ~ "Long Draw Reservoir"
    ))
}

# Shared plotting function so both plots stay visually identical
make_sdd_plot <- function(data, pre_lines, post_lines) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = mean_sdd)) +
        geom_line(data = pre_lines, aes(x = date, y = sdd_fit), color = "steelblue",
               linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    geom_line(data = post_lines, aes(x = date, y = sdd_fit), color = "steelblue",
               linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    geom_point(color = "gray70", alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = trend), color = "goldenrod", size = 1.5) +

    geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2020-08-01"), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    ROSS_theme +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(position = "left", breaks = seq(0, 8, by = 2), limits = c(0, 8), transform = "reverse") +
    labs(x = "Date", y = "Estimated Secchi Disk Depth (m)")
}
```

## Temp post-fire slopes by site

```{r}
 seasonAdjTrends_temp <-  map_dfr(unique(all_rs$site_code), function(site){
    #use time_decompose to remove seasonal component
    all_rs %>% 
    mutate(doy = yday(date))%>%
    filter(site_code == site & !is.na(med_surface_C) & (doy >= 120 & doy <= 300))%>%
    select(site_code,gnis_name, date, med_surface_C)%>%
    as_tibble() %>% 
    arrange(date) %>%
    time_decompose(med_surface_C, merge = T) 
  })%>%
   filter(site_code %nin% c("HORR", "COMR", "SEMR", "HALL"))  %>%
   filter(year(date) > 2020 & !is.na(trend) & med_surface_C > 0)%>%
  bind_rows(
    map_dfr(unique(rs_tests$site_code), function(i) {
      tibble(seq(from = as.Date("2020-12-31"), to = as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "1 year"))%>%
        rename(date = 1)%>%
        mutate(trend = NA, med_surface_C = NA, site_code = i, pre_fire = "Post-Fire")
    })
  )%>%
  mutate(gnis_name = case_when(
    site_code == "BRNR" ~ "Barnes Meadow Reservoir",
    site_code == "PTRR" ~ "Peterson Lake",
    site_code == "CBRR" ~ "Chambers Lake",
    site_code == "JOER" ~ "Joe Wright Reservoir",
    site_code == "LNGR" ~ "Long Draw Reservoir"
  ))

library(zyp)

sens_slopes_trend_temp <- seasonAdjTrends_temp %>%
  filter(!is.na(trend)) %>%
  arrange(site_code, date) %>%
  mutate(decimal_year = lubridate::decimal_date(date)) %>%
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  summarize(
    test_trend    = list(zyp.sen(trend ~ decimal_year, data = cur_data())),
    test_med_surface_C = list(zyp.sen(med_surface_C ~ decimal_year, data = cur_data())),
    kendall_trend    = list(cor.test(decimal_year, trend, method = "kendall")),
    kendall_med_surface_C = list(cor.test(decimal_year, med_surface_C, method = "kendall")),
    date_min = min(date),
    date_max = max(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trend_slope     = map_dbl(test_trend, ~ .x$coefficients[["decimal_year"]]),
    trend_intercept = map_dbl(test_trend, ~ .x$coefficients[["Intercept"]]),
    trend_p_value   = map_dbl(kendall_trend, ~ .x$p.value),
    trend_z_stat    = map_dbl(kendall_trend, ~ .x$statistic),
    trend_p_sig     = if_else(trend_p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"),
    
    med_surface_C_slope     = map_dbl(test_med_surface_C, ~ .x$coefficients[["decimal_year"]]),
    med_surface_C_intercept = map_dbl(test_med_surface_C, ~ .x$coefficients[["Intercept"]]),
    med_surface_C_p_value   = map_dbl(kendall_med_surface_C, ~ .x$p.value),
    med_surface_C_z_stat    = map_dbl(kendall_med_surface_C, ~ .x$statistic),
    med_surface_C_p_sig     = if_else(med_surface_C_p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_trend, -test_med_surface_C, -kendall_trend, -kendall_med_surface_C) %>%
  arrange(trend_slope) %>%
  select(site_code, date_min, date_max,
         trend_slope, trend_intercept, trend_p_value, trend_z_stat, trend_p_sig,
         raw_med_surface_C_slope = med_surface_C_slope, raw_med_surface_C_intercept = med_surface_C_intercept,
         raw_med_surface_C_p_value = med_surface_C_p_value, raw_med_surface_C_z_stat = med_surface_C_z_stat, raw_med_surface_C_p_sig = med_surface_C_p_sig)

trend_lines <- sens_slopes_trend_temp %>%
  mutate(
    decimal_year_min = lubridate::decimal_date(date_min),
    decimal_year_max = lubridate::decimal_date(date_max)
  ) %>%
  # pivot into long form: one row per site per endpoint
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(decimal_year_min, decimal_year_max),
    names_to = "endpoint",
    values_to = "decimal_year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    date = lubridate::date_decimal(decimal_year) %>% as.Date(),
    trend_fit = trend_intercept + trend_slope * decimal_year,
    med_surface_C_fit   = raw_med_surface_C_intercept + raw_med_surface_C_slope * decimal_year
  ) %>%
  select(site_code, date, trend_fit, med_surface_C_fit) %>%
  mutate(gnis_name = case_when(
    site_code == "BRNR" ~ "Barnes Meadow Reservoir",
    site_code == "PTRR" ~ "Peterson Lake",
    site_code == "CBRR" ~ "Chambers Lake",
    site_code == "JOER" ~ "Joe Wright Reservoir",
    site_code == "LNGR" ~ "Long Draw Reservoir"
  ))

ggplot(seasonAdjTrends_temp,
       aes(x = date, y = trend)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "goldenrod") +
  geom_point(aes(y = med_surface_C), color = "gray", alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_surface_C), linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid", color = "gray", alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Sen's slope trend lines
  geom_line(data = trend_lines, aes(x = date, y = trend_fit), color = "red",
             linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = trend_lines, aes(x = date, y = med_surface_C_fit), color = "black",
             linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  facet_wrap(~gnis_name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Date", 
    y = "Lake Surface Temperature (°C)", 
    title = "Post-Fire Data (2021-2024)", 
    subtitle = "Red lines: Sen's slope for time_decomposed Temp; Black lines: Sen's slope for raw Temp"
  ) +
  ROSS_theme

```

## SI Table 1: PO4 detections over time


Looking at where PO4 is present (above 0.01 detection limit) and if that
is changing over time
```{r}
# How many samples per study reservoirs

tidy_chem%>%
  filter( site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4, PO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  filter(param == "PO4")%>%
  group_by(site_code, burn_group)%>%
  summarise(samples = n(), 
           all_samples = sum(value),
            abv_nd  = sum(value > 0))%>%

# How many samples per year at study reservoirs

tidy_chem%>%
  filter( site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4, PO4), 
               names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value")%>%
  filter(param == "PO4")%>%

  summarise(samples = n(), 
           all_samples = sum(value),

# How many samples at mainstem/stream sites

tidy_chem%>%
  filter( site_code %nin% all_reservoirs)%>%
  filter(site_code %nin% c("BEAV", "PENN", "SAWM", "LBEA" ))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ChlA,Turbidity, TSS, DTN,  DOC:NO3, SO4, PO4),

           all_samples = sum(value),

  arrange(desc(perc_abv_nd))

```

```{r}

upper_PO4 <- filter(tidy_chem, watershed %nin% c("CLP Mainstem - Lower","CLP Tributary - Lower"))%>%
  select(site_code,location_type, Date, Turbidity, PO4, Year)%>%
  mutate(location_type = case_when(
    site_code %in% c("JWC", "BEAV", "LBEA", "PENN", "SFM", "SAWM", "JOEI", "CBRI", "COMI", "HORI") ~ "Tributary",
    TRUE ~ location_type))%>%
  group_by(location_type, Year)%>%
  # fina what percent of each year had PO4 levels above 0.01 and get the mean level for each location type and year
  summarise(total_samples = n(),
            PO4_perc_dect = sum(PO4 >= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)/n()* 100,
            #calculate mean of PO4 for only samples above 0.01, excluding samples lower than 0.01
            mean_PO4 = mean(PO4[PO4 >= 0.01], na.rm = TRUE),
            samples = paste0(sum(PO4 >= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),"/",n() ))%>%
  # pivot wider by year
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = c(total_samples, PO4_perc_dect, mean_PO4, samples)) %>%
  mutate(across(total_samples_2021:mean_PO4_2024, ~replace_na(.x, 0)))%>%
  mutate(across(samples_2021:samples_2024, ~replace_na(.x, "0/0")))%>%
  # if a column is numeric, round it to 2 decimal places
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2)))%>%
  arrange(factor(location_type, levels = c("Inflow", "Reservoir", "Outflow", "Mainstem", "Tributary")))%>%
  select(location_type, total_samples_2021:mean_PO4_2024)
```

## SI Table 2: Mean, SD, Max for nutrients for reservoirs

Calculate mean, sd and max for key constituents for the 7 main study
reservoirs

```{r}

key_table <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("LNGR", "JOER","COMR", "HORR",  "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")) %>%
  select(site_code, Year, pH,SC,TSS, DOC, DTN, K,NH4,NO3, SO4) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pH,SC,TSS, DOC, DTN, K,NH4,NO3, SO4),
               names_to = "parameter",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  #get the median and max for each site
  group_by(site_code, parameter) %>%
  summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(median, max, sd),
               names_to = "stat",
               values_to = "stat_value")%>%
  unite("param_stat", parameter, stat, sep = " ") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_stat, values_from = stat_value)%>%
  arrange(factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "HORR", "COMR", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  select(site_code:`NO3 sd`,`SO4 median`:`pH sd`, `SC median`,`SC max`,`SC sd`)%>%
  #round all numeric values to 2 digits
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))


param_oi <- c( "DOC", "DTN", "K", "NH4", "NO3", "SO4", "TSS", "pH", "SC")

params <- chem_units %>%
  filter(simple %in% param_oi) %>%
  arrange(match(simple, param_oi)) %>%
  pull(Parameters)


# Create a basic flextable
ft2 <- key_table %>%
  rename(Site = site_code) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    .labels = setNames(rep(c("mean", "max", "sd"), times = length(params)),
                      nm = as.vector(t(outer("", c("median", "max","sd"), paste, sep = " "))))) %>%
  delete_part(part = "header")%>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", rep(c("Median", "Max", "SD"), times = length(params))),  
    colwidths = c(1, rep(1, length(params)*3))  # Adjust colwidths for Site and parameters
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("Site", params), 
    colwidths = c(1, rep(3, length(params)))  # Adjust colwidths for Site and parameters
  ) %>%
  
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", 
                "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", 
               "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹", "mg L⁻¹",  " ", "µS cm⁻¹"), 
    colwidths = c(1, rep(3, length(params)))  # Adjust colwidths again to match
  ) %>%
  merge_v(j = ~Site) %>%
  merge_h(part = "header") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  border_outer() %>%
  border_inner_v() %>%
  border_inner_h() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)%>%
  autofit()

sect_properties <- prop_section(
  page_size = page_size(
    orient = "landscape",
    width = 8.3, height = 11.7
  ),
  type = "continuous",
  page_margins = page_mar()
)

save_as_docx( ft2, path = here(paper_draft_dir,"SI_2_table.docx"))

```

## SI Fig: Percent of reservoir samples eutrophic status

In cold water lakes (our study sites), mesotrophic levels are defined as
between 2.6 and 8 µg/L, and eutrophic levels are greater than 8 µg/L.
Under 2.6 µg/L is considered Oligotrophic.

```{r}

chla_status_site_year <- tidy_chem%>%
  filter(!is.na(ChlA))%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res)%>%
  mutate(eu_status  = case_when(ChlA >= 2.6 &ChlA <= 8 ~ "Mesotrophic", 
                                ChlA > 8 ~ "Eutrophic",
                                ChlA < 2.6 ~ "Oligotrophic"))%>%
  group_by(site_code, Year, eu_status, burn_group)%>%
  summarise(eu_stats = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = eu_status, values_from = eu_stats)%>%
  mutate_at(vars(-Year), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(total_samples = sum(c(Eutrophic, Mesotrophic, Oligotrophic)),
    perc_eu = round((Eutrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
         perc_meso = round((Mesotrophic/total_samples)*100, digits= 1),
         perc_meso_eu = round(((Eutrophic+Mesotrophic)/total_samples)*100, digits= 1), 
        perc_oligo = round((Oligotrophic/total_samples) *100, digits= 1),
    Year = as.character(Year))

all_years <- chla_status_site_year%>%
  group_by(burn_group)%>%
  summarise(total_samples = sum(total_samples), 
            perc_eu = sum(Eutrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_meso = sum(Mesotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_meso_eu = sum(Eutrophic + Mesotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100, 
            perc_oligo = sum(Oligotrophic)/sum(total_samples)*100)

long_chla_status <- chla_status_site_year%>%
  select(site_code, Year, total_samples, perc_eu, perc_meso, perc_meso_eu, perc_oligo)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(perc_eu, perc_meso, perc_meso_eu, perc_oligo), names_to = "category", values_to = "value" )

long_chla_status$site_code = factor(long_chla_status$site_code, levels = c("LNGR","JOER" , "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR" ))

chla_status <- c(
  perc_eu = "% eutrophic",
  perc_meso = "% mesotrophic ",
  perc_meso_eu = "% mesotrophic & eutrophic",
  perc_oligo = "% oligotrophic"
)

#PLOT
 long_chla_status%>%
  filter(site_code %in% primary_study_res )%>%
   filter(category != "perc_meso_eu")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = value,group = site_code, color =  site_code))+
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code)+
 geom_line()+
   geom_point()+
  theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
facet_wrap(~category, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(category = chla_status))+
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of chlorophyll-*a* samples", 
    color = "Reservoir")+
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())

```

## SI Fig: C & N Timelines with Chl-a
```{r}
# Make a plot of C:N ratios for each reservoir over time, facet by year and include ChlA for that reservoir on 

all_sites_data <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% all_reservoirs & ChlA < 15) %>%
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  complete(Date = seq.Date(min(Date), max(Date), by = "month")) %>%
  # Data processing steps
  mutate(
    C_N_ratio = DOC / DTN,
    month = month(Date)
  ) %>%
  # Keep winter NAs to break lines, otherwise keep sampled rows
  filter(month %in% c(11, 12, 1, 2) | (!is.na(NO3) & month %in% c(3:10))) %>%
  ungroup()

prim_range <- range(c(all_sites_data$DTN, all_sites_data$NO3), na.rm = TRUE)
sec_range <- range(all_sites_data$ChlA, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(all_sites_data, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = DTN, color = "DTN"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = NO3, color = "NO3"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = scales::rescale(ChlA, to = prim_range, from = sec_range), color = "ChlA"), 
            linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = DTN, color = "DTN"), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = NO3, color = "NO3"), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~site_code, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Parameter",
    values = c("DTN" = "#ED553B", "NO3" = "#20639B", "ChlA" = "#3CAEA3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Nitrogen Concentration (mg/L)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ scales::rescale(., to = sec_range, from = prim_range), 
      name = "Chlorophyll a (μg/L)"
    )) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#3CAEA3"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Reservoir Nitrogen & Algal Dynamics",
    subtitle = "Lines break during winter sampling gaps",
    x = "Date" )
```

# Scratch

## Reservoir N and Chla Hysteresis 

```{r}

#start with BRNR, make a plot of ChlA vs NO3 and ChlA vs DTN for each reservoir separately, facet by year and include a line connecting the points in chronological order to show hysteresis patterns. Use different colors for each year to distinguish them.

n_labels <- c(
  "N_NO3" = "NO[3]^'-'-N~(mg~L^-1)",  
  "DTN"   = "DTN~(mg~L^-1)"
)

plot_data_clean <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(!is.na(NO3) & !is.na(ChlA) & !is.na(DTN)) %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c("BRNR", "CBRR","LNGR","JOER","PTRR")) %>% 
  mutate(
    doy = yday(Date), 
    N_NO3 = NO3 / 4.43
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(N_NO3, DTN), names_to = "N_param", values_to = "N_value")

make_reservoir_plot <- function(site_df) {
  current_site <- unique(site_df$site_code)
  
  ggplot(site_df, aes(x = N_value, y = ChlA, color = doy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_path(arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.08, "inches")), alpha = 0.6) +
    
    facet_grid(Year ~ N_param, labeller = labeller(N_param = as_labeller(n_labels, default = label_parsed))) +
    
    # Scales and styling
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#03045e", mid = "#59B851", high = "#FA850E", midpoint = 225,limits = c(100,300)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    xlim(0, 1.25) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Reservoir Reaches:", current_site),
      x = "Nitrogen Concentration", 
      y = chem_expressions$ChlA, 
      color = "DOY"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

reservoir_plots <- plot_data_clean %>% 
  group_split(site_code) %>% 
  map(make_reservoir_plot)

final_grid <- wrap_plots(reservoir_plots, ncol = 2) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

final_grid

```


## NDVI
```{r}
ndvi <- read_csv("data/raw/spatial/res_study/ndvi_res_yearly_peaks.csv")%>%
  rename(Year = year)

pre_fire_ndvi <- ndvi %>%
  filter(Year < 2020) %>%
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  summarise(pre_fire_ndvi = mean(peak_ndvi, na.rm = TRUE))

norm_ndvi <- ndvi %>%
  mutate(burn_factor = if_else(site_code %in% c("COMR", "HORR", "CBRR", "BRNR", "PTRR"), "Burned", "Unburned"))%>%
  #normalize peak_ndvi by pre_fire_ndvi for each site
  left_join(pre_fire_ndvi, by = "site_code") %>%
  mutate(norm_peak_ndvi = peak_ndvi/pre_fire_ndvi)%>%
  filter(site_code %in% c(primary_study_res, "COMR", "HORR"))

norm_ndvi%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = peak_date, y = norm_peak_ndvi, color = site_code)) +
  geom_line()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2020-08-01"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code)+
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, by = 1))+
  #facet_wrap(~burn_factor)+
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Watershed Normalized Peak NDVI", color = "Reservoir", caption = "Normalized by pre-fire NDVI for each catchment (norm = peak_ndvi / mean(pre_fire_peak_ndvi))")+
  ROSS_theme
  



ndvi_yearly_chem <- tidy_chem %>%
  filter(site_code %in% c(primary_study_res, "COMR", "HORR"))%>%
  #only use 2023 and 2024 data from COMR and HORR
  filter(!(site_code %in% c("COMR", "HORR") & Year < 2023))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TSS:SO4), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")%>%
  #compute yearly geometric mean for each site
  group_by(site_code, Year, parameter)%>%
  summarise(median = exp(mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 
            median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))%>%
  left_join(norm_ndvi, by = c("site_code", "Year"))

 plot_data <- ndvi_yearly_chem %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("ChlA", "Cl", "DOC", "NO3", "DTN", "K", "SC", "SO4"))

# Compute p-value for each parameter's lm fit
pvals <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(p_value = tryCatch(
    glance(lm(median ~ norm_peak_ndvi, data = cur_data()))$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )) %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "solid", "dashed"))

# Join significance flag back to plotting data
plot_data %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "parameter")%>%
  mutate(site_code = factor(site_code, levels = c("LNGR", "JOER", "HORR", "COMR", "CBRR", "PTRR", "BRNR")))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = median, color = site_code, shape = as.factor(Year))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = median, linetype = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_poly_eq(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = median, 
                    label = paste(after_stat(rr.label), after_stat(p.value.label), sep = "~~~")),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               formula = y ~ x,
               parse = TRUE,
               size = 4,
               label.x = "left",
               label.y = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsBS_site_code) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 18, 15)) +
  scale_linetype_identity() +
  labs(x = "Watershed Normalized Peak NDVI", y = "Yearly Site Median", color = "Reservoir", shape = "Year", caption = "Dashed lines indicate non-significant relationships") +
  ROSS_theme

plot_data <- ndvi_yearly_chem %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("ChlA", "Cl", "DOC", "NO3", "DTN", "K", "SC", "SO4"))

# Compute p-value for each parameter's lm fit
pvals <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(p_value = tryCatch(
    glance(lm(max ~ norm_peak_ndvi, data = cur_data()))$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )) %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "solid", "dashed"))

# Join significance flag back to plotting data
plot_data %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "parameter")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = max, color = site_code, shape = as.factor(Year))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = max, linetype = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_poly_eq(aes(x = norm_peak_ndvi, y = max, 
                    label = paste(after_stat(rr.label), after_stat(p.value.label), sep = "~~~")),
```

## Landcover

```{r}

#pull in watersheds
watersheds <- st_read(dsn = here(spatial_dir,"cpf_watersheds.shp"))%>%
  left_join(most_recent_meta, by = c("site_code"))

nlcd_tiffs <- list.files(here(external_spatial, "landcover_NLCD"), pattern = "Annual_NLCD_LndCov",  full.names = T)%>%
  #find the files that contain ".tff" and nothing after it
  .[grepl(".tiff$", .)]
# read in rasters and name them based on the year contained in the file name
nlcd_rasters <- map(nlcd_tiffs, raster::raster)
#name them based on the year contained in the file name
names(nlcd_rasters) <- nlcd_tiffs%>%
  stringr::str_extract("\\d{4}")%>%
  as.numeric()


compute_top3_landcovers <- function(year){
  
  NLCD <- nlcd_rasters[[year]]
  
  nlcd_raster <- raster::brick(NLCD)


  ws <- watersheds %>%
    select(site_code)%>%
    rownames_to_column('index')%>%
    mutate(index = as.numeric(index))
  
  # using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
  # ArcGIS speak
  ws_NLCD <- exactextractr::exact_extract(nlcd_raster, ws,
                                         append_cols = "index",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           group_by(lc_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                           summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 'lc_code', values_from = 'count',
                names_glue = "{lc_code}" ) %>%
    inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_NLCD
  
  ws_percents <- ws_NLCD %>% 
    #if there are NAs, change it to 0
    mutate(across(`11`:`82`, ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(water=100*(`11`/total),
           ice_snow=100*(`12`/total),
           open_space=100*(`21`/total),
           developed = 100*((`22`+ `23`+ `24`)/total),
           Barren = 100*(`31`/total),
           `Decidious Forest` = 100*((`41`)/total),
           `Evergreen Forest` = 100*((`42`)/total),
           `Mixed Forest` = 100*((`43`)/total),
           `Shrubland` = 100*((`52`)/total),
           `Grassland` = 100*((`71`)/total),
           pasture = 100*((`81`)/total),
           crops = 100*((`82`)/total),
           `Wetlands` = 100*((`90`+ `95`)/total),
           total_check = rowSums(across(water:Wetlands)))%>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
    select(total, site_code, water:total_check)
  
  
  top_land_cover <- ws_percents %>%
    select(-total, -total_check) %>%
  # Pivot longer to get land cover types and percentages in rows
  pivot_longer(cols = water:Wetlands, 
               names_to = "land_cover", 
               values_to = "percent")%>%
  # Group by site_code and find the top 4 land covers by percent
  group_by(site_code) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% # Rank the top 4 land covers
  ungroup() %>%
  # Pivot wider with unique column names
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = site_code, 
    names_from = rank, 
    values_from = c(land_cover, percent), 
    names_glue = "{.value}_{rank}"
  )%>%
    select(site_code, land_cover_1, percent_1, land_cover_2, percent_2, land_cover_3, percent_3)%>%
    mutate(nlcd_year = year)%>%
    #round all percent columns to 1 decimal places
    mutate(across(contains("percent"), ~round(., 1)))


return(top_land_cover)
  
  
}

compute_all_landcovers <- function(year){
  
  NLCD <- nlcd_rasters[[year]]
  
  nlcd_raster <- raster::brick(NLCD)


  ws <- watersheds %>%
    select(site_code)%>%
    rownames_to_column('index')%>%
    mutate(index = as.numeric(index))
  
  # using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
  # ArcGIS speak
  ws_NLCD <- exactextractr::exact_extract(nlcd_raster, ws,
                                         append_cols = "index",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           group_by(lc_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                           summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
    group_by(index) %>% 
    mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 'lc_code', values_from = 'count',
                names_glue = "{lc_code}" ) %>%
    inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_NLCD
  
  all_land_cover <- ws_NLCD %>% 
    #if there are NAs, change it to 0
    mutate(across(`11`:`82`, ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(water=100*(`11`/total),
           ice_snow=100*(`12`/total),
           open_space=100*(`21`/total),
           developed = 100*((`22`+ `23`+ `24`)/total),
           Barren = 100*(`31`/total),
           `Decidious Forest` = 100*((`41`)/total),
           `Evergreen Forest` = 100*((`42`)/total),
           `Mixed Forest` = 100*((`43`)/total),
           `Shrubland` = 100*((`52`)/total),
           `Grassland` = 100*((`71`)/total),
           pasture = 100*((`81`)/total),
           crops = 100*((`82`)/total),
           `Wetlands` = 100*((`90`+ `95`)/total),
           total_check = rowSums(across(water:Wetlands)))%>%
    st_drop_geometry()%>%
    select( site_code, total, water:`Wetlands`)%>%
    mutate(nlcd_year = year)

return(all_land_cover)
  
  
}

years <- c("2019", "2023")

ws_lc <- map_df(years, compute_top3_landcovers)%>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  #swapping water for land_cover_3
  mutate(land_cover_2 = case_when(land_cover_2 == "water" ~ land_cover_3, 
                                  TRUE ~ land_cover_2), 
         percent_2 = case_when(land_cover_2 == "water" ~ percent_3, 
                               TRUE ~ percent_2), 
         # creating a new column that combines the top 2 land covers for table
         land_cover_top2 = paste0(land_cover_1, " (", percent_1, " %) \n",land_cover_2, " (", percent_2," %) " ))%>%
  select(site_code, nlcd_year,land_cover_top2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = nlcd_year, values_from = land_cover_top2, names_prefix = "lc_top2_")

#run to get all landcover %s for watersheds
ws_all_lc <- map_df(years, compute_all_landcovers)%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = water:Wetlands, 
    names_to = "landcover", 
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  select(-total)%>%
  pivot_wider(,
    names_from = nlcd_year, 
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "value_" # This creates value_2019 and value_2023
  ) %>%
  select(site_code, landcover, value_2019, value_2023)%>%
  mutate(pp_change = value_2023 - value_2019)


rm(years)
```

## Slope, elevation and aspect

```{r}

ws_chars<- map_dfr(unique(watersheds$site_code), function(ws_code){
  
  ws <- watersheds %>%
    filter(site_code == ws_code)
  
   ws <- st_make_valid(ws)
  
  if(ws_code %in% c("JOER", "CBRR", "BRNR", "LNGR", "PTRR", "COMR","HORR")){
    z_num = 10
  }else{
    z_num = 9
  }
  
  elev <- get_elev_raster(ws, z = z_num, verbose = F)

  ws_elev <- exactextractr::exact_extract(elev, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           summarise(mean_elev = mean(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     max_elev = max(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     min_elev = min(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select(site_code, mean_elev, max_elev, min_elev)
  
  
  #calculate slope
  slope <- raster::terrain(elev, opt = "slope", unit = "degrees", verbose = F)
  ws_slope <- exactextractr::exact_extract(slope, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                           summarise(mean_slope = mean(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     max_slope = max(value, na.rm = T), 
                                                     min_slope = min(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select( mean_slope, max_slope)
  
  #calculate aspect
  aspect <- raster::terrain(elev, opt = "aspect", unit = "degrees")
  ws_aspect <- exactextractr::exact_extract(aspect, ws,
                                         append_cols = "site_code",
                                         summarize_df = T,
                                         fun=function(x) x %>%
                                          summarise(mean_aspect = mean(value, na.rm = T))) %>%
    select(mean_aspect)%>%
    round(2)
  # calculate watershed area
  ws_area <- st_area(ws)%>%
    #convert to km2
    units::set_units("km^2")
  
  bind_cols(ws_elev, ws_slope, ws_aspect)%>%
    mutate(ws_area_km2 = ws_area)
  
})

```

```{r}
#get the snow persistence raster

ws_snow <- map_dfr(unique(watersheds$site_code),  function(ws_code){

    filter(site_code == ws_code)
  exactextractr::exact_extract(snow, ws,

                                                      max_snow = max(value, na.rm = T),

    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 0)))%>%

           mean_snow_free_date= format(as.Date(days, origin = "2020-01-01"), "%m-%d"))%>%
    select(site_code, mean_snow, mean_snow_free_date)
})
```

## Soil Burn Severity

From Rhoades 2025 paper : "We partitioned the catchments into groups based on the proportional area burned at high + moderate severity (Extensive:>50%, High: 25–50%, Mid:<25%). Unburned catchments and those with <25% total burn extent, no high severity and little moderate severity (0–13%) were included in a No/Low class."

```{r}

sbs <- terra::rast(here(spatial_dir, "cpf_sbs_BAER.tif"))

# Load the shapefile and raster
ws <- st_read(here(spatial_dir, "cpf_watersheds.shp")) %>%
  st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbs)) 

ws_raster <- ws %>%
  terra::vect()

# Ensure all NA values in the raster are already set to 5
sbs[is.na(sbs) | is.null(sbs) | sbs == 0] <- 5

# Get the extent of the ws vector
ws_extent <- terra::ext(ws_raster)

# Extend the raster to match the ws extent, assigning new areas the value of 5 (Unburned)
sbs_extended <- terra::extend(sbs, ws_extent, fill = 5)

# Get the cell size in map units (meters)
cell_size <- terra::res(sbs_extended)

cnv_to_km2 <- (cell_size[1] * cell_size[2]) / 1e6

# using the exactextractr package, get what is essentially a "zonal histogram" in
# ArcGIS speak
ws_extracted_sbs <- exactextractr::exact_extract(sbs_extended %>% raster::raster(), ws,
                                              append_cols = "site_code",
                                              summarize_df = T,
                                              fun=function(x) x %>%
                                                group_by(sbs_code = as.character(value)) %>%
                                                summarise(count = sum(coverage_fraction))) %>%
  group_by(site_code)%>%
  mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'sbs_code', values_from = 'count',
              names_glue = "sbs{sbs_code}" ) %>%
  inner_join(ws, .) -> ws_sbs

ws_sbs_full <- ws_extracted_sbs %>% 
  ungroup()%>%
  st_drop_geometry()%>%
  #if a column is NA change it to 0
  mutate(across(starts_with("sbs"), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Define raw pixel counts for burn classes
    Unburned = sbs5 + sbs6,
    `Very Low` = sbs1,
    Low = sbs2,
    Moderate = sbs3,
    High = sbs4,
    
    # 2. Convert to Square Kilometers (km2)
    Unburned_km2 = Unburned * cnv_to_km2,
    VeryLow_km2 = `Very Low` * cnv_to_km2,
    Low_km2 = Low * cnv_to_km2,
    Moderate_km2 = Moderate * cnv_to_km2,
    High_km2 = High * cnv_to_km2,
    total_km2 = total * cnv_to_km2,
    
    # 3. Calculate Percentages (Assumes 'total' column exists in raw pixels)
    Unburned_pct = (Unburned / total) * 100,
    VeryLow_pct = (`Very Low` / total) * 100,
    Low_pct = (Low / total) * 100,
    Moderate_pct = (Moderate / total) * 100,
    High_pct = (High / total) * 100
  )%>%
  mutate(across(Unburned:High_pct, ~round(., 1)))%>%
  mutate(extent_burned = ((`Very Low` + Low + Moderate + High)),
         extent_burned_km2 = extent_burned * cnv_to_km2,
         extent_burned_pct = (extent_burned / total) * 100,
         high_burn = (Moderate + High)/total*100,
         burn_class = case_when(high_burn > 50 ~ "Extensive", 
                                high_burn > 25 & high_burn <= 50 ~ "High", 
                                high_burn < 25 & Moderate_pct <= 13 & high_burn <= 5 ~ "No/Low",
                                TRUE ~ "Mid"), 
         low_pct = Low_pct + VeryLow_pct)

ws_sbs_concise <- ws_sbs_full%>%
  #filter(site_code %in% c("CBRR", "BRNR", "PTRR","COMR", "HORR", "JOER", "LNGR"))%>%
  select(site_code, 
         `Total Area (km2)` = total_km2,
         `Extent Burned (km2)` = extent_burned_km2,
         `Extent Burned (%)` = extent_burned_pct,
         `High Burn (%)` = High_pct, 
        `Moderate Burn (%)` = Moderate_pct,
        `Low Burn (%)` = low_pct,
         `Watershed Burn Class` = burn_class)

```

```{r}
      # 1. Define raw pixel counts for burn classes
```
