```{r}
      VeryLow_km2 = `Very Low` * cnv_to_km2,
      Low_km2 = Low * cnv_to_km2,
      Moderate_km2 = Moderate * cnv_to_km2,
      High_km2 = High * cnv_to_km2,
      total_km2 = total * cnv_to_km2,
      
      # 3. Calculate Percentages (Assumes 'total' column exists in raw pixels)
      Unburned_pct = (Unburned / total) * 100,
      VeryLow_pct = (`Very Low` / total) * 100,
      Low_pct = (Low / total) * 100,
      Moderate_pct = (Moderate / total) * 100,
      High_pct = (High / total) * 100
    )%>%
    mutate(across(Unburned:High_pct, ~round(., 1)))%>%
    mutate(extent_burned = ((`Very Low` + Low + Moderate + High)),
           extent_burned_km2 = extent_burned * cnv_to_km2,
           extent_burned_pct = (extent_burned / total) * 100,
           high_burn = (Moderate + High)/total*100,
           burn_class = case_when(high_burn > 50 ~ "Extensive",

                                  high_burn < 25 & Moderate_pct <= 13 & high_burn <= 5 ~ "No/Low",
                                  TRUE ~ "Mid"))
  
  ws_burn_info <- ws_sbs_concise %>%
    left_join(waterbody_buffer_percents %>% 
                select(site_code,
```

```{r}
# # Switch to interactive mode

  "#FD8D3C", # 3: Moderate (Orange)
  "#E31A1C", # 4: High (Red)
  "#31A354", # 5: Unburned (Green)
```

## Flow data

```{r}

api_creds <- yaml::read_yaml(file = "creds/CDWRCreds.yml")$api_key

# pull dwr claftcco data from 1980-2021
q_data <- get_sw_ts(abbrev = "CLAFTCCO", timescale = "day", start_date = "1980-10-01", end_date = "2020-09-30", api_key = api_creds)
  
q_data_clean <- q_data%>%
  mutate(q_cfs = value, 
           site_code = abbrev, 
         acre_ft_day = q_cfs *1.983 )%>%
    distinct()%>%
  # remove rows where flag_b is "Ice"
  filter(!grepl("Ice", flag_b))%>%
  select(abbrev, Date = datetime, q_cfs, acre_ft_day, flag_a, flag_b)%>%
  dataRetrieval::addWaterYear()

q_annual <- q_data_clean%>%
  group_by(waterYear)%>%
  summarise(t_flow_acft = round(sum(acre_ft_day), 0), 
            max_cfs = max(q_cfs), 
            #find the Date with the highest q_cfs per year
            max_cfs_date = Date[which.max(q_cfs)],
            )%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(peak_dy = yday(max_cfs_date), 
         month = month(max_cfs_date), 
         t_flow_cm = round(t_flow_acft * 1233.48, 0)) # convert acre-feet to cubic meters

mean(q_annual$t_flow_acft)
mean(q_annual$t_flow_cm)/1e6
```

## Prism Precip

```{r}

# 1. Setup
# Set a directory for PRISM to store the large .bil files
prism_set_dl_dir("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip", create = T)
aoi <- st_read("data/raw/spatial/res_study/cpf_watersheds.shp")%>%
  filter(site_code == "PFAL")

# 2. Download Data
# Download 800m Normals (PPT)
get_prism_normals(type = "ppt", resolution = "4km", annual = TRUE, keepZip = FALSE)


# Download Annual data for 2021-2024
get_prism_annual(type = "ppt", years = 2021:2026,resolution = "4km", keepZip = FALSE)


# 1. Load the Annual Data (2021-2024)
annual_files <- prism_archive_subset(
  type = "ppt", 
  years = 2021:2026, 
  resolution = "4km", 
  temp_period = "annual"
)
r_annuals <- terra::rast(pd_to_file(annual_files))

# 2. Load the 30-Year Normals (manual due to file naming issues)
r_normal <- terra::rast("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y.tif")


# 5. Spatial Extraction
# Ensure AOI and Rasters are in the same CRS (PRISM is usually NAD83)
aoi_transformed <- st_transform(aoi, st_crs(r_normal))

# Calculate mean precipitation across the AOI for each layer
precip_stats <- tibble(
  period = c("Normal", names(r_annuals)),
  precip_mm = unlist(c(
    exact_extract(r_normal, aoi_transformed, 'mean'),
    exact_extract(r_annuals, aoi_transformed, 'mean')
  ))
)

# 6. Clean and Compare
comparison_df <- precip_stats %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract year from PRISM filename or label
    year = case_when(
      period == "Normal" ~ "1991-2020 Normal",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(period, "\\d{4}")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(year, precip_mm) %>%
  # Calculate deviation from normal
  mutate(
    normal_val = precip_mm[year == "1991-2020 Normal"],
    diff_mm = precip_mm - normal_val,
    pct_of_normal = (precip_mm / normal_val) * 100
  )

print(comparison_df)

other_years <- comparison_df%>%filter(!(year %in% c("1991-2020 Normal", "2025")))
other_years$diff_mm
mean(other_years$diff_mm)

# Quick visualization
ggplot(comparison_df %>% filter(year != "1991-2020 Normal"), 
       aes(x = year, y = precip_mm)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = normal_val), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Annual Precipitation vs. 30-Year Normal",
       subtitle = "Red dashed line indicates 1991-2020 normal",
       y = "Precipitation (mm)", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Snow vs Rain

```{r}

get_prism_normals(type = "ppt", resolution = "4km", mon = 1:12, keepZip = FALSE)
get_prism_normals(type = "tmean", resolution = "4km", mon = 1:12, keepZip = FALSE)


# Stack all months for precip and temp
ppt_files  <- tibble(
  base  = "data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip/",
  extra = "prism_ppt_us_25m_",
  end = "_avg_30y",
  month = 1:12
) %>%
  mutate(file = if_else(
    month < 10,
    paste0(extra, "2020", "0", month, end),
    paste0(extra, "2020",       month,end)
  ), 
  path = paste0(base, file, "/", file, ".tif"))%>%
  pull(path)

tmean_files <- tibble(
  base  = "data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip/",
  extra = "prism_tmean_us_25m_",
  end = "_avg_30y",
  month = 1:12
) %>%
  mutate(file = if_else(
    month < 10,
    paste0(extra, "2020", "0", month, end),
    paste0(extra, "2020",       month,end)
  ), 
  path = paste0(base, file, "/", file, ".tif"))%>%
  pull(path)


ppt_stack   <- rast(ppt_files)
tmean_stack <- rast(tmean_files)
aoi <- st_read("data/raw/spatial/res_study/cpf_watersheds.shp")%>%
  filter(site_code == "PNF")
aoi <- transform(aoi, crs(ppt_stack))
# Crop and mask to AOI
ppt_aoi <- mask(crop(ppt_stack, vect(aoi)), vect(aoi))

# Months 1-4 and 10-12 are snow, 5-9 are rain
snow_months <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12)
rain_months  <- c(5, 6, 7, 8, 9)

total_ppt_mm  <- global(sum(ppt_aoi),               sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum
total_snow_mm <- global(sum(ppt_aoi[[snow_months]]), sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum
total_rain_mm <- global(sum(ppt_aoi[[rain_months]]), sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum

# Basin-wide percent
pct_snow <- (total_snow_mm / total_ppt_mm) * 100
pct_rain <- (total_rain_mm / total_ppt_mm) * 100

cat("Snow:", round(pct_snow, 1), "%\n")
cat("Rain:", round(pct_rain, 1), "%\n")
```

### Summer Precip

```{r}
# # Set PRISM directory and load AOI
# prism_set_dl_dir("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip", create = TRUE)
# 
aoi <- st_read("data/raw/spatial/res_study/cpf_watersheds.shp") %>%
  filter(site_code == "PFAL")

# 1. Download Monthly PPT data for June-Sept (months 6:9) across 2020-2025
get_prism_monthlys(
  type = "ppt", 
  years = 2020:2025, 
  mon = 6:9, 
  resolution = "4km", 
  keepZip = FALSE
)

# 2. Subset downloaded archives for June-Sept 2020-2025
monthly_files <- prism_archive_subset(
  type = "ppt",
  temp_period = "monthly",
  years = 2020:2025,
  mon = 6:9,
  resolution = "4km"
)

# 1. Load files into a SpatRaster stack
r <- pd_to_file(monthly_files) %>% rast()

# 2. Transform AOI to match the raster CRS dynamically
aoi_proj <- st_transform(aoi, crs(r))

# 3. Crop and Mask to your AOI watershed
precip_stack <- r %>% 
  terra::crop(aoi_proj) %>% 
  terra::mask(aoi_proj)

# 4. Group layers by Year and calculate sum for each year (June–Sept total)
# Extract years from layer metadata/names
layer_years <- pd_get_name(monthly_files) %>% 
  stringr::str_extract("\\d{4}")

# Sum layers belonging to the same year
yearly_summer_ppt <- tapp(precip_stack, index = layer_years, fun = "sum")
names(yearly_summer_ppt) <- paste0("Year_", unique(layer_years))

# 5. Convert raster to dataframe for ggplot
precip_df <- as.data.frame(yearly_summer_ppt, xy = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Year_"), 
    names_to = "Year", 
    names_prefix = "Year_", 
    values_to = "summer_ppt_mm"
  )

layer_years <- pd_get_name(monthly_files) %>% 
  stringr::str_extract("\\d{4}")

yearly_ppt <- tapp(r, index = layer_years, fun = "sum")
names(yearly_ppt) <- paste0("Year_", unique(layer_years))

# 2. Ensure watershed vector geometry shares the raster projection
ws_proj <- st_transform(ws, terra::crs(r))

# 3. Extract and average pixel values within each watershed per year
# (fun = "mean" gets watershed-average depth in mm; swap to "sum" if you need total volume)
ws_precip_extracted <- terra::extract(
  yearly_ppt, 
  ws_proj, 
  fun = mean, 
  na.rm = TRUE, 
  bind = TRUE
)

# 4. Convert spatial vector attributes to dataframe and pivot long
ws_precip_df <- as.data.frame(ws_precip_extracted) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Year_"), 
    names_to = "Year", 
    names_prefix = "Year_", 
    values_to = "yearly_ppt_mm"
  ) %>%
  select(site_code, Year, yearly_ppt_mm)

```

## PRISM Summer Temp

```{r}

# 2. Download Data
# Download Monthly Normals (TMEAN) for June-Sept
get_prism_normals(type = "tmean", resolution = "4km", mon = 4:10, keepZip = FALSE)

# Download Monthly data for June-Sept for years 2021-2025 
# (Note: 2026 data is not yet available for all summer months)
get_prism_monthlys(type = "tmean", years = 2021:2025, mon = 4:10, keepZip = FALSE)

# 3. Load and Average the Summer Normals (June-Sept)
folders <- list.files("data/raw/external_datasets/prism/precip",pattern = "avg",full.names = T)%>%grep("tmean",., value = T)

#files in each folder with nothing after ".tif"
files <- map(folders, list.files, full.names = T, recursive = T, pattern = "\\.tif$")%>%
  flatten_chr()
#read in files
r_normals <- rast(files)


# 2. Load all Individual Monthly Rasters (2021-2025)
# We grab all months at once instead of averaging them in a loop
annual_monthly_folders <- prism_archive_subset(type = "tmean", temp_period = "monthly", years = 2021:2025, mon = 4:10, resolution = "4km")
r_monthlies <- rast(pd_to_file(annual_monthly_folders))

# 3. Spatial Extraction
aoi_transformed <- st_transform(aoi, st_crs(r_normals))

# Extract Normals
df_normals <- tibble(
  layer_name = names(r_normals),
  normal_temp = unlist(exact_extract(r_normals, aoi_transformed, 'mean'))
) %>%
  mutate(month = str_extract(layer_name, "(?<=2020)\\d{2}")) # Extract month from "...._06"

# Extract Actuals
df_actuals <- tibble(
  layer_name = names(r_monthlies),
  actual_temp = unlist(exact_extract(r_monthlies, aoi_transformed, 'mean'))
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = str_extract(layer_name, "\\d{4}"),
    month = str_extract(layer_name, "\\d{4}(\\d{2})", group = 1) # Extract month
  )

# 4. Join and Compare
comparison_df <- df_actuals %>%
  left_join(df_normals %>% select(month, normal_temp), by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    diff_c = as.numeric(actual_temp - normal_temp),
    month_name = month.abb[as.numeric(month)]
  ) %>%
  # Order months correctly for plotting
  mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = c("Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct")))

print(comparison_df)

# 5. Visualization: Faceted by Month
ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = year, y = actual_temp)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = diff_c > 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~month_name, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(yintercept = normal_temp, ymin = normal_temp, ymax = normal_temp, color = "Normal"), 
                linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "firebrick"), labels = c("Cooler", "Warmer"), name = "Status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Normal" = "black"), name = "Reference") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Temperature Comparison (June-Sept)",
    subtitle = "Comparing individual months to their respective 1991-2020 Normals",
    y = "Mean Temperature (°C)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
  group_by(waterYear)%>%
  summarise(t_flow_acft = round(sum(acre_ft_day), 0), 
            max_cfs = max(q_cfs), 
            #find the Date with the highest q_cfs per year
            max_cfs_date = Date[which.max(q_cfs)],
  )%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(peak_dy = yday(max_cfs_date), 
         month = month(max_cfs_date), 
         t_flow_cm = round(t_flow_acft * 1233.48, 0), 
         M_cm = t_flow_cm/1000000) # convert acre-feet to cubic meters)

m_ditch %>%
  summarise(mean_M_cm = mean(M_cm))
```

## Outflow vs reservoir temp

```{r}

#CBRI is listed as "Chambers Inflow" so we need to recode it to JOER outflow

temp_delta <- tidy_chem%>%
  mutate(location_type = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Outflow", location_type), 
         watershed = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Joe Wright Reservoir", watershed))%>%
  filter(location_type %in% c("Outflow", "Reservoir"))%>%
  select(site_code, Date, temp = Field_Temp_C, location_type, watershed)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Date, watershed), names_from = location_type, values_from = temp)%>%
  filter(!is.na(Outflow) & !is.na(Reservoir))%>%
  mutate(temp_delta = Outflow - Reservoir, 
         temp_ratio = Reservoir/Outflow)

chla_delta  <- tidy_chem%>%
  mutate(location_type = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Outflow", location_type), 
         watershed = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Joe Wright Reservoir", watershed))%>%
  filter(location_type %in% c("Outflow", "Reservoir"))%>%
  select(site_code, Date, ChlA, location_type, watershed)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Date, watershed), names_from = location_type, values_from = ChlA)%>%
  filter(!is.na(Outflow) & !is.na(Reservoir))%>%
  mutate(chla_delta = Outflow - Reservoir, 
         chla_ratio = Reservoir/Outflow)

no3_delta <- tidy_chem%>%
  mutate(location_type = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Outflow", location_type), 
         watershed = if_else(site_code == "CBRI", "Joe Wright Reservoir", watershed))%>%
  filter(location_type %in% c("Outflow", "Reservoir"))%>%
  select(site_code, Date, NO3, location_type, watershed)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Date, watershed), names_from = location_type, values_from = NO3)%>%
  filter(!is.na(Outflow) & !is.na(Reservoir))%>%
  mutate(no3_delta = Outflow - Reservoir, 
         no3_ratio = Reservoir/Outflow)


temp_delta%>%
```

```{r}
#Get stage data
structures <- cdssr::get_structures(water_district = 3)%>%
  filter(!is.na(longdecdeg) & !is.na(latdecdeg))%>%
  filter(structure_type == "RESERVOIR")%>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longdecdeg", "latdecdeg"), crs = 4326)

wdids <- structures%>%
  filter(grepl("MOUNTAIN SUPPLY RES 20|CHAMBERS LAKE RES|LONG DRAW RESERVOIR|PETERSON LAKE RES|COMANCHE RES|BIG BEAVER RES|BARNES MEADOW RESERVOIR", structure_name))

res_stage <- map(wdids$wdid, function(wdid) {
  cdssr::get_structure_stage_ts(wdid = wdid, start_date = "2000-10-01", end_date = "2025-09-30", api_key = api_creds)
  
})

res_stage_clean <- bind_rows(res_stage) %>%
  left_join(structures %>% select(wdid, structure_name), by = "wdid") %>%
  select(wdid, structure_name, Date = datetime, stage_ft = stage, volume_ac_ft = volume) %>%
  mutate(site_code = case_when(
    structure_name == "BARNES MEADOW RESERVOIR" ~ "BRNR",
    structure_name == "BIG BEAVER RES" ~ "HORR",
    structure_name == "CHAMBERS LAKE RES" ~ "CBRR",
    structure_name == "COMANCHE RES" ~ "COMR",
    structure_name == "LONG DRAW RESERVOIR" ~ "LNGR",
    structure_name == "MOUNTAIN SUPPLY RES 20" ~ "JOER",
    structure_name == "PETERSON LAKE RES" ~ "PTRR"
  )) %>%
  filter(stage_ft < 200) %>% # remove non-realistic values
  filter(!(stage_ft == 0 & site_code == "JOER"))%>%
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2021-01-01")) %>%
   group_by(site_code, structure_name) %>%
   padr::pad(interval = "day") %>% 
  mutate(
    stage_ft = zoo::na.approx(stage_ft, na.rm = FALSE),
    volume_ac_ft = zoo::na.approx(volume_ac_ft, na.rm = FALSE)
   ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage_scaled = scales::rescale(stage_ft, to = c(0, 1)),
    volume_scaled = scales::rescale(volume_ac_ft, to = c(0, 1))
   ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(watershed = case_when(site_code == "BRNR" ~ "Barnes Meadow Reservoir",
                               site_code == "HORR" ~ "Hourglass Reservoir",
                               site_code == "CBRR" ~ "Chambers Reservoir",
```

### Split data and t-test

```{r}
full_data <- stage_ratios %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_value))%>%
  group_by(watershed)%>%
  mutate(stage_scaled = scales::rescale(stage_ft, to = c(0, 1)))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(!(watershed == "Barnes Meadow Reservoir" & ratio_value >20))%>%
  mutate(status = if_else(stage_scaled > 0.5, "High Stage", "Low Stage"))

# 1. Run t-tests and create significance labels
t_test_results <- full_data %>%
  #exclude temp for barnes meadow
  filter(!(watershed == "Barnes Meadow Reservoir" & parameter == "temp_ratio")) %>%
  group_by(parameter, watershed) %>%
  summarise(t_test = list(t.test(ratio_value ~ status)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    t_statistic = map_dbl(t_test, ~ .$statistic),
    p_value = map_dbl(t_test, ~ .$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(parameter,watershed,  t_statistic, p_value) %>%
  # Create a clean label column based on p-value significance
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE            ~ "" # 'ns' for non-significant, or use "" if you want it blank
  ))

# 2. Create a helper dataframe for positioning the labels on the plot
# This calculates the max value of each parameter to place the star right above the data
label_positions <- full_data %>%
  group_by(parameter, watershed) %>%
  summarise(y_pos = max(ratio_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5, .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(t_test_results, by = c("parameter", "watershed")) %>%
  # We place the label horizontally in the center of the x-axis (at 1.5, between the two boxes)
  mutate(x_pos = 1.5) 

# 3. Plot with geom_text using the helper dataframe
ggplot(full_data, aes(x = status, y = ratio_value, fill = status)) +
  geom_violin() +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", size = 0.7, color = "black", fill = "white") +
  # Add the significance labels
  geom_text(
    data = label_positions, 
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = sig_label), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE, # Prevent it from looking for 'fill' or 'status' in label_positions
    size = 8, 
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(parameter~ watershed, scales = "free_y")+
  labs(
    title = "Reservoir vs Outflow Parameter Ratios by Stage Status",
    subtitle = "High Stage > 0.5, Low Stage <= 0.5",
    x = "Reservoir Stage Status", 
    y = "Ratio (Reservoir/Outflow)", 
    fill = "Stage Status"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  ROSS_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High Stage" = "steelblue", "Low Stage" = "firebrick"))
```
